docai_lines.text: The object of this study is the technical assisted reproduction and the ethical issues
that are developed with the use of biomedical technology. Nowadays, people have the
ability to obtain children in other ways than the normal way.
However, the possibility of implementing scientific methods for childbearing, such as
the surrogate mother or through the donation of genetic material, raises moral issues in
society. There are organizations in modern societies that oppose the application of
biomedical techniques for the purpose of human reproduction, which is the cause of the
creation of moral barriers and confrontations between members of society.
Keywords: Bioethics, Principals of Bioethics, Infertility, Technically Assisted Reproduction,
